# T-2: Record broad mode

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Add explicit broad mode opt-in with non-empty reason and an audit record that downstream commands can verify.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Broad mode cannot be enabled with an empty reason.
- Broad mode records step, reason, timestamp, and currentTaskId at the time of opt-in.
- get-next-action returns broad implement only when the audit record matches step=implement.
- Review or gate broad execution succeeds only when the audit record matches the attempted broad step.

## Implementation Notes
Expose the smallest CLI surface that fits existing flow set/run command patterns. Validate user-facing args at the entry point. Store audit data in flow state using the existing append-only state style. The implement entrypoint is get-next-action: it may return flow-level run-impl only when broad mode has an audit record for step=implement.

## Test Strategy
Command tests for valid and invalid broad mode opt-in plus command preflight behavior with and without the record.
